verdict.rationale: Navan documents an official hosted MCP server at mcp.navan.com/mcp. Setup is documented for Claude (a `claude mcp add` command), a Cursor plugin and a VS Code mcp.json file. Authentication uses the user's Navan login and permissions, and the docs list the tool capabilities (spend, travel, policy, card queries). A probe confirms the MCP docs and llms.txt are live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Navan MCP lets you connect Navan to your favorite AI products, so you can query Navan spend and travel data using natural language.
claude mcp add --transport http --scope user navan https://mcp.navan.com/mcp
All clients connect to the same hosted MCP server — auth, TLS, and updates are handled for you.
Authentication uses your Navan login (SSO or username/password) under the signed-in user's permissions.
